pandas.DataFrame.join

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Combine tables using index labels or a specified key in the calling table.

Call syntax

DataFrame.join(…) Full signature
DataFrame.join(
    other,
    on=None,
    how='left',
    lsuffix=…,
    rsuffix=…,
    sort=False,
    validate=None,
    *,
    suffixes=…,
)

ParameterRequirementAccepted values and behavior
other
      Required
Positional or keyword

      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default None		
      str, list of str, or array-like

how
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default 'left'		
      {'left', 'right', 'outer', 'inner', 'cross', 'left_anti', 'right_anti'}

Positional or keyword

Positional or keyword

      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default False

Choose whether the resulting labels or groups are sorted where supported.


validate
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default None		
      str
Check that key multiplicity matches the required relationship, such as "one_to_one" or "many_to_one".


suffixes
      Optional
Keyword only		
      tuple of (str, str)
Supply a pair for resolving duplicate column names in joined tables.
